# Experiment log (generated by scripts/report_tables.py)

One card per trained general-topic model, in the format of the project brief. Protocol, the other experiments (subtopics, calibration, OOD, decay) and the discussion: docs/EXPERIMENTS.md and docs/MODEL_REPORT.md. Development splits only; the locked holdout is evaluated once in reports/locked/results.json.

### E-1.1 · `tfidf-word|logreg`

| field | value |
|---|---|
| Model | multinomial logistic regression, class_weight=balanced |
| Features | TF-IDF word 1-2-grams (lower-cased, sublinear tf, min_df 2, max_df 0.9, <=200k features) |
| Hyper-parameters | C=16.0 (chosen on val macro-F1; grid: C over {1, 4, 16} (TF-IDF) or {0.5, 2, 8, 32} (embeddings)) |
| Train metrics | acc 1.000, macro-F1 1.000, weighted-F1 1.000, ECE 0.080 |
| Validation metrics | Wikipedia val: acc 0.811, macro-F1 0.805, weighted-F1 0.812, ECE 0.041 · Stack Exchange ext_dev: acc 0.607, macro-F1 0.593, weighted-F1 0.612, ECE 0.026 |
| Training time | 16.8 s (vectorizer + head fit) |
| Inference time | median 1.5 ms / p95 1.8 ms per text, batch 0.05 ms/text; size 9.9 MB |
| Notes | train-val macro-F1 gap 0.195 (memorises the training set) |
| Decision | Not selected: strong on Wikipedia, weak transfer to real questions (lexical overlap with encyclopedic text). |

### E-5 · `finetune_minilm-l6`

| field | value |
|---|---|
| Model | shared transformer encoder (mean pooling) + general head (class-weighted cross-entropy) + subtopic head (BCE) |
| Features | sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings (frozen, 384-d, L2-normalised), fine-tuned end to end |
| Hyper-parameters | lr 5e-05, epochs 3 (best epoch by val macro-F1), batch 32, max 64 tokens, AdamW, linear warm-up; subtopic threshold 0.25 (val) |
| Train metrics | per-epoch training loss: 0.8981, 0.4601, 0.3324 |
| Validation metrics | Wikipedia val: acc 0.857, macro-F1 0.848, weighted-F1 0.858, ECE 0.065, subtopic macro-F1 0.433 · Stack Exchange ext_dev: acc 0.772, macro-F1 0.749, weighted-F1 0.765, ECE 0.117 |
| Test metrics | not computed (development splits only; locked holdout: reports/locked/results.json) |
| Training time | 2386.5 s on cpu (epoch 1: 798.1 s, epoch 2: 1051.0 s, epoch 3: 537.3 s) |
| Inference time | median 12.66 ms per text; 90.9 MB |
| Notes | val macro-F1 by epoch: 0.8434, 0.8446, 0.8482 |
| Decision | The fine-tuned encoder is exported and used with logistic-regression heads (row minilm-l6-ft above), which keeps the artifact format, temperature scaling and OOD gate of the frozen encoders. |
